title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.01153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. translated_title: 超越两次循环：循环混合专家模型的可扩展方案
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer引入了循环深度作为大语言模型的一种新扩展维度：通过反复应用共享的Transformer块，它们在不增加参数量的情况下提升了有效深度。然而，在计算量（FLOPs）匹配的比较下，循环对于大型MoE（混合专家）大语言模型的收益仍不明确。其主要原因是额外迭代带来的收益会迅速递减，甚至可能转变为性能退化，因此花费在循环上的额外计算量几乎没有带来实质性改进。因此，先前的工作通常只采用两次循环。我们识别出扩展循环MoE的两大主要障碍。首先，循环继承并放大了“深度诅咒”：随着残差更新的累积，隐状态方差在每次迭代中不断增长，这破坏了深度循环的稳定性并导致表示漂移。其次，循环MoE遭受“专家选择坍缩”问题：路由器在各次循环中反复选择相同的专家，因此额外的迭代只增加了计算量……
tldr: 该论文揭示了循环MoE扩展的两大障碍——隐状态方差增长的深度诅咒放大与路由器重复选择相同专家的选择坍缩，并提出了一个可扩展的循环MoE方案，使循环次数能够突破传统的两次并获得持续收益。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two key obstacles to scaling looped Mixture-of-Experts—amplified curse of depth via growing hidden-state variance and expert selection collapse—and proposes a scalable recipe that enables looping beyond twice with sustained benefits.
